data.one_liner: Manage device screen wake state and brightness on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows developers to read and set screen brightness, check if the screen is kept awake, and prevent the device from going into sleep mode. It supports both Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to keep the screen awake during specific app activities
You need to read or adjust screen brightness programmatically
avoid_when: You do not need to interact with screen wake or brightness controls
strengths: Simple API for managing screen wake and brightness
weaknesses: Requires manual Android manifest permission configuration
Limited to screen wake and brightness functionality
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the WAKE_LOCK permission to the Android Manifest.
